title: Burgundy Cutout Gown
prompt: An original young woman with long, loose blonde waves stands indoors near a pale wall and a wood floor. She wears a fitted burgundy strapless maxi dress with horizontal sheer cut-outs at the midriff. Gold bangles stack on her wrists, and a small gold pendant sits at her throat. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, warm interior light. Palette of burgundy, cream, and warm gold. Glamorous and sleek, in the style of an evening wear campaign.
workingNotes:
- The sheer cut-outs and bangles are the defining details.
- Keep the wood floor for a warm, lived-in setting.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the wood floor for a lived-in setting.
